inputs.name: qdrant_version
inputs.description: Qdrant release to install, without the leading v.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the musl release tarball for each architecture, x86_64 and aarch64, from the release page. Change these with qdrant_version.

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: Address the REST and gRPC APIs listen on. The default keeps Qdrant to the host itself; "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: api_key
inputs.description: Key every API request must send in an api-key header. When null, the APIs take requests without one. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_api_key; it never reaches state.

inputs.name: storage_path
inputs.description: Directory Qdrant keeps its collections in.

inputs.name: telemetry_disabled
inputs.description: Stop Qdrant sending anonymous usage statistics to its developers. Set false to send them.
